prompt: Six distinct finely hand painted miniature city building sprites in a 3 column by 2 row atlas, each separated completely by transparent space. Transparent background. Top row: small bus waiting station cream masonry terracotta roof; compact museum limestone with skylight sawtooth roof; small music theater red brick with curved copper auditorium roof. Bottom row: community sports gym modest timber barrel roof tall windows; market hall green iron glass roof brick arched stalls; small civic clock tower cream stone with a low attached cultural room. No labels, no text, no roads, no people, no vehicles, no surrounding landscape or diamond slabs. All six fully visible. Match premium detailed isometric city game sprites. Fixed orthographic 2:1 isometric ground axes +/-0.5, vertical edges vertical, warm upper-left sunlight. Compact rectangular footprints, no giant stadium or railway terminal. Each building unique massing facade windows and roof. Generous transparent space between six sprites for extraction. 1536x1024 atlas if supported.
extraction: 三个512宽区域；前两列按y=512分行；第三列按y=490分行保留钟楼尖顶，剧院512×490、钟楼512×534。分离仅裁切，不变色、不拉伸、不重命名旧图。
